name: Akiyama Fuuka
source:
Fuuka is a second-year high school student, [url=/c38032]Kazuma[/url]'s childhood friend and the president of the student council. Fuuka has always attracted the attention of others, possessing foreign blood in addition to belonging to an extremely wealthy family, her being has always radiated an irresistible charm that curves men and women at her feet. Very charismatic and very popular, many have already confessed their feelings to her, but she has always rejected all confessions. Just since she entered high school, Fuuka has already rejected more than 500 confessions, out of a high school with 800 students with a ratio of 400 boys and 400 girls.

However, Fuuuka is not disinterested in love. In reality, and secretly, she has been in love with Kazuma for a very long time but she never dared to take the first step. She has already tried to seduce him in middle school by giving him a blowjob but Kazuma never tried to approach her afterwards, despite her attempts to seduce him. Frustrated and thinking that she may not be beautiful enough for him, she wishes to her plush [url=/c38029]Kyuutarou[/url] to give to Kazuma a power of hypnotist so that he can finally respond to her advances.
